roadmap.title: Early gears and Bombeach
roadmap.description: Collect gears in the levels open at the start, visit a hat store, and reach 6 gears so Bombeach opens.

roadmap.title: Early levels and small tasks
roadmap.description: Beat Bomboss, finish the Arcade Panik and Pizza Time tasks, and do the easy Granny's Island, Gym and Morio's Lab tasks. Collect the gears and golden bunnies in the early levels as you go.

roadmap.title: Tosla's Offices
roadmap.description: Reach 50 gears, use the golden spring, enter the secret room and beat Alien Mosk.

roadmap.title: City, Crash Test and Fecal Matters
roadmap.description: Finish Maurizio's City and Crash Test Industries, press the orange button, and open Fecal Matters.

roadmap.title: Morio's Mind and the sewers
roadmap.description: Talk to Morio after Crash Test Industries, take the key in Morio's Mind and enter the sewers.

roadmap.title: Observatory and Tosla HQ
roadmap.description: Use the Golden Propeller, look through the telescope and finish Tosla HQ to reach the Moon.

roadmap.title: The Moon and the ending
roadmap.description: Touch a golden object, start the final boss fight and win it.

roadmap.title: After the ending
roadmap.description: Collect every gear in Mosk's Rocket and open the Observatory's locked door with the Mosk Hat.

roadmap.title: Full collection
roadmap.description: Finish every per-level gear and golden bunny achievement.

achievements.description: Unlock Bombeach!
achievements.summary: Unlock Bombeach by collecting 6 gears.

steps.text: Collect 6 gears in the levels you can already enter. @loc{Bombeach} then opens.

achievements.description: Defeat Bomboss and fix the ice cream truck
achievements.summary: Beat Bomboss at the top of the Bombeach hill and repair the ice cream truck.

steps.text: Climb the hill in @loc{Bombeach} and beat @enemy{Bomboss} at the summit.

achievements.description: Help Pizza King!
achievements.summary: Help Pizza King by removing the 5 corrupted pizza slices.

guide.context: @loc{Pizza Time} opens after you collect 32 gears.

steps.text: In @loc{Pizza Time}, get rid of all 5 corrupted pizza slices.

achievements.description: Enter the locked door in Morio's Lab.
achievements.summary: Enter the locked door in Morio's Lab.

guide.context: The door's security only lets you through while you wear the @item{Morio Hat}.

steps.text: Get the @item{Morio Hat} from the hat store on @loc{Granny's Island} and wear it.
In @loc{Morio's Lab}, interact with the locked door.

achievements.description: Well, you did strike. Pretty self explanatory!
achievements.summary: Get a strike with a bowling ball in Arcade Panik.

guide.context: @loc{Arcade Panik} opens after you collect 18 gears.

steps.text: In @loc{Arcade Panik}, roll a bowling ball at the pins until you get a strike. There are several places to do it.

achievements.description: Use the Golden Spring!
achievements.summary: Use the Golden Spring in Tosla's Offices.

guide.context: @loc{Tosla's Offices} opens after you collect 50 gears.

steps.text: Find the golden spring inside @loc{Tosla's Offices} and interact with it.

achievements.description: Enter the secret door in Tosla's Offices.
achievements.summary: Open the secret door inside Tosla's Offices.

guide.context: The door's security only lets you through while you wear the @item{Monster Hat}.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Monster Hat}, found outside @loc{Tosla's Offices}, and wear it.
Walk up to the secret door inside @loc{Tosla's Offices} and use it.

achievements.description: But not the war!
achievements.summary: Defeat Alien Mosk in Tosla's Offices.

achievements.description: Talk to Ultra Chad and get some tips!
achievements.summary: Talk to Ultra Chad in Gym Gears.

guide.context: @loc{Gym Gears} opens once the Flip O' Will is unlocked.

achievements.description: Full of cool doggos!
achievements.summary: Enter Fecal Matters.

guide.context: Fecal Matters needs the Flip O' Will unlocked and Tosla's Offices beaten.

achievements.description: Enter the sewers!
achievements.summary: Enter the sewers.

guide.context: It needs the Flip O' Will unlocked and all orange blocks activated.

achievements.description: Help Maurizio with his... Problem
achievements.summary: Complete Maurizio's City by bumping Maurizio's behind.

guide.context: @loc{Maurizio's City} needs @loc{Tosla's Offices} beaten and 65 gears.

achievements.description: Activate all orange blocks!
achievements.summary: Activate all orange blocks.

guide.context: @loc{Crash Test Industries} needs @loc{Tosla's Offices} beaten and 80 gears. The button powers the orange blocks that join parts of other levels.

steps.text: Near the end of @loc{Crash Test Industries}, press the orange button.

achievements.description: Find the password inside Morio's mind!
achievements.summary: Get the key at the end of Morio's Mind.

steps.text: After beating @loc{Crash Test Industries}, talk to @npc{Morio}.
Enter @loc{Morio's Mind} and finish it by taking the key.

achievements.displayName: I can see my house from here
achievements.description: Use the Golden Propeller for the first time
achievements.summary: Use the Golden Propeller for your first time.

steps.text: Use the @item{Golden Propeller} at the entrance of the @loc{Ruined Observatory}.

achievements.description: Take a peak at The Moon!
achievements.summary: Look through the telescope outside the Ruined Observatory.

steps.text: Interact with the telescope outside the @loc{Ruined Observatory}.

achievements.description: Follow Alien Mosk to the Moon.
achievements.summary: Finish Tosla HQ, then chase Alien Mosk to the Moon.

guide.context: @loc{Tosla HQ} opens after Morio's Mind is beaten and you have 130 gears.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Tosla HQ}, then chase @enemy{Alien Mosk} to the Moon.

achievements.description: Start the boss fight inside the spaceship.
achievements.summary: Start the boss fight inside the spaceship on the Moon.

steps.text: Enter the spaceship on the Moon and start the boss fight.

achievements.description: Beat the game.
achievements.summary: Beat the game.

steps.text: Win the boss fight inside the spaceship on the Moon.

achievements.description: Touch a golden object on the Moon.
achievements.summary: Touch a golden object on the Moon.

steps.text: Touch any golden object on the Moon. Many are scattered across it.

achievements.description: Find the secret library in the Ruined Observatory.
achievements.summary: Enter the locked door inside the Ruined Observatory.

guide.context: A powerup stops the door from recognising your hat, so use up its charges before trying the door.

steps.text: Beat the game, then take the @item{Mosk Hat} from the Tosla Offices section of @loc{Mosk's Rocket} and wear it.
Use up any powerup charges you have, then use the locked door inside the @loc{Ruined Observatory}.

achievements.description: *Farting Noises*
achievements.summary: Talk to the 3 TIMES MMA WORLD CHAMPION at the top of the hill.

steps.text: On @loc{Granny's Island}, walk up the hill and talk to the @npc{3 TIMES MMA WORLD CHAMPION}.

achievements.description: Read the plaque on Grandma's Statue
achievements.summary: Read the plaque on the statue of Grandma.

steps.text: On @loc{Granny's Island}, use the plaque on @loc{Grandma's Statue}.

achievements.description: Too many working Mori-O-Trons!
achievements.summary: Bump into several @enemy{Mori-O-Tron} machines to break them.

steps.text: Find @enemy{Mori-O-Tron} machines in any level and bump into them until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Destroy 50 Scenario Objects!
achievements.summary: Destroy 50 destructible scenario objects.

steps.text: Bump into breakable objects in any level until you have destroyed 50.

achievements.description: Get the gear in the clouds!
achievements.summary: Collect the gear on the last cloud on Granny's Island.

steps.text: On @loc{Granny's Island}, cross the clouds to the last one and take the gear there.

achievements.displayName: Does this make my Bumper look big?
achievements.description: Visit the Hat Store
achievements.summary: Enter a hat shop for the first time.

steps.text: Enter any hat shop. One is on @loc{Granny's Island}; others are in @loc{Crash Test Industries}, @loc{Maurizio's City}, @loc{Pizza Time}, @loc{Arcade Panik} and @loc{Bombeach}.

achievements.description: Collect your first golden bunny!
achievements.summary: Collect one golden bunny.

steps.text: Pick up any @item{Golden Bunny}. Almost every level has one.

achievements.description: Collect all Golden Bunnies!
achievements.summary: Collect every golden bunny in the game.

steps.text: Finish every per-level golden bunny achievement, then collect the golden bunnies in @loc{Morio's Lab}, which have no achievement of their own.

achievements.description: Collect all gears!
achievements.summary: Collect every gear in the game.

steps.text: Finish every per-level gear achievement, including @loc{Mosk's Rocket}, then collect the gears in @loc{Morio's Lab}, which have no achievement of their own.
